title: A structurally coherent, STAT-regulated dark proteome in Penaeus monodon hemocytes
description:
Code and derived results for a calibrated protein-language-model approach to protein function annotation, evaluated under progressive withdrawal of homologous evidence and applied to the STAT-dependent uncharacterised fraction of the Penaeus monodon hemocyte proteome.

  • Fmax, all benchmark queries (ESM-2, whitened): 0.815 [0.801, 0.829]
  • Benchmark queries: 1,087
  • Fmax on proteins with no BLAST-class hit: 0.664 [0.599, 0.732]
  • Proteins with no BLAST-class hit: 94
  • Fmax after iterative-profile hardening: 0.625 [0.542, 0.706]
  • Proteins with no hit from either search: 70
  • STAT-dependent uncharacterised targets annotated: 328
  • …of which have no reachable homologue: 190
  • Spearman |δ| vs expression decile: +0.84 (p = 0.002)
